The '''Pakuuni system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]].

==History==
The Pakuuni system was a major haven for both [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] around at the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which caused galactic trade there to be difficult; some would say dangerous at best. [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], however, set up a new installation there, from which he restored order to the system. Attempts on the part of both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and [[Pakuuni Pirates]] to stop Thrawn from building the new base failed.<ref name="TIE" />
